Vulnerabilities.Title: JDBC Driver for SQL Server has improper input validation issue
Vulnerabilities.Description: Improper input validation in JDBC Driver for SQL Server allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

Vulnerabilities.Title: org.apache.httpcomponents.core5/httpcore5: Apache HttpComponents Core: Denial of Service via excessive HTTP headers
Vulnerabilities.Description: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerability in the HTTP/1.1 message parser in Apache HttpComponents Core (5.4.2 and earlier, 5.5-beta1 and earlier) allows an remote attacker to cause a denial of service through memory exhaustion by sending messages with excessive number of headers / excessive header length

Vulnerabilities.Title: org.apache.httpcomponents.core5/httpcore5-h2: Apache HttpComponents Core: Denial of Service via oversized HTTP/2 HPACK header blocks
Vulnerabilities.Description: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling in the HTTP/2 HPACK decoder in Apache HttpComponents Core (5.4.2 and earlier, 5.5-beta1 and earlier) allows an remote attacker to cause a denial of service through memory exhaustion by sending oversized compressed header blocks before the HTTP/2 SETTINGS acknowledgement causes the configured header list size limit to be applied.
